period_note: Filed by the bank as a discrete '2nd Quarter' filing. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2023. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2024) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR quality is good for the data pages (the cover page rendered as unreadable noise, not a data loss). DISCREPANCY FOUND, NOT RECONCILED: this filing's own 31-Dec-2023 comparative Total Assets (10,737,399,326) and Total Liabilities (23,607,522,415/23,607,322,415, two slightly different OCR reads of the same cell) are both approximately BDT 52m higher than the Dec-2023 figures used consistently elsewhere in this dataset (2023_Q4.json's 10,685.39m / 23,555.31m, also matching this bank's own 2024_Q1.json and 2024_Q3.json filings' Dec-2023 comparatives exactly) -- traced to this filing's own 'Fixed assets including premises' Dec-2023 comparative (216,486,806) versus the ~52m-smaller figure (164,478,768) shown for the same line/date in the 2024_Q1 filing. Total Shareholders' equity for Dec-2023 is UNAFFECTED and matches exactly (-12,869,923,089) across all filings, so this looks like an isolated asset/liability classification slip in this one filing's comparative column (reverted to the original figures in the very next quarter's filing, 2024_Q3), not a genuine progressive restatement -- the current-period (30-Jun-2024) figures reported below are this filing's own primary figures and are not affected either way. As in other quarters, the source's 'Total provision (D)' line is printed as a plain positive figure regardless of charge/release direction; the true sign (-20.0m, a net recovery) is derived as C minus the reported PBT. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT). EPS is printed as -0.43 in this filing's own Notes section, but PAT/664,702,300 shares recomputes to -0.42 (a sub-cent rounding difference); both figures are recorded (see metric_note).
